t: A tiny Wi-Fi camera cube from M5Stack that also works as a webcam.
steps: Buy the AtomS3R-CAM from the M5Stack store or The Pi Hut.
Plug it into a computer with a USB-C cable and open any video call app to see the webcam.
Install M5Burner and flash the UiFlow2 firmware.
Open the UiFlow2 web editor and build a first program with blocks.
Try the Arduino IDE with the ESP32 board package for camera examples.
Plug a Grove sensor into the side port and print its readings.
Add the Atomic Echo Base to try the AI chatbot guide.
